mute.reason: These ARE the secret-detector's fixtures. The scanner is right to see them; a detector that missed its own test data would be broken. Fourteen accepted findings, muted in config rather than deleted, so the suppression is reviewable.

shadcn/ui kit is installed as a catalogue; unused primitives are expected. The scanner already collapses them to one info — mute keeps dogfood focused on this repo's own code.
